units.source_text: 夫人又问了两三个问题，我全都不记得了。

en.t: The lady asked two or three more questions, but I have forgotten all of them.

units.source_text: 夫人像男子一样性格爽快，不同于一般的女人，跟夫人谈这种事情的时候，感觉格外痛快顺畅。

en.t: The lady had a frank, almost masculine disposition, unlike ordinary women, and speaking with her about such matters felt especially easy and pleasant.

units.source_text: 最后夫人对我说：‘好吧，就许配给你吧。’

en.t: At last the lady said to me, "Very well, I will give her to you."

units.source_text: 然后，夫人转而又拜托我：‘我们这样的小户人家，或许够不上说什么许配给你的身份，请你娶了她吧。

en.t: Then the lady turned it around and asked me, "For a small household like ours, we may not be in a position to speak grandly of giving her to you; please take her as your wife.

units.source_text: 你也知道，她是个没有父亲的可怜孩子。’

en.t: As you know, she is a poor child with no father."

units.source_text: 这件事就这么三言两语地谈妥了，从开始到结束恐怕都不到十五分钟。

en.t: The matter was settled in just a few words, and from beginning to end it probably took less than fifteen minutes.

units.source_text: 夫人没有提出任何条件，还说也不必同亲戚们商量，回头知会他们一声就可以了，

en.t: The lady set no conditions at all, and said there was no need to consult the relatives; it would be enough to inform them afterward,

units.source_text: 甚至说连小姐本人的意思也不用问。

en.t: and she even said there was no need to ask the young lady herself what she thought.

units.source_text: 在这个问题上，我这个有知识的人，反倒显得拘泥于形式了。

en.t: On this point, I, the educated one, seemed instead to be the person clinging to formalities.

units.source_text: 我提醒夫人，亲戚的意见单说，还是应该先问问小姐本人的想法，她答应了再说。

en.t: I reminded the lady that, leaving the relatives aside, we should first ask the young lady herself what she thought and proceed only after she agreed.

units.source_text: 她本人不愿意的话，我是不会把她嫁给你的。’

en.t: If she herself does not want it, I would never marry her off to you."

units.source_text: 我回到自己的房间后，想到事情进行得如此顺风顺水，心里反倒打起鼓来。

en.t: After I returned to my room, the thought that things had gone so smoothly made me uneasy instead.

units.source_text: 脑子里甚至冒出了疑问：我真的可以放心吗？

en.t: A question even rose in my mind: could I really feel at ease?

units.source_text: 但是，大体上说，我未来的命运已经就此定了下来，这个念头刷新了我的一切。

en.t: But broadly speaking, the thought that my future fate had now been settled renewed everything in me.
